methodology.baseline: Latest completed player game versus prior three available completed games.
methodology.targetShare: Targets divided by all team's recorded player targets in the same game after player/game deduplication; prior and season shares use summed numerators and denominators. Any missing player target count makes that team/game denominator and shares unknown.
methodology.score: 50 + 50 × weighted normalized usage change, clipped to 0–100. WR/TE targets 55% (scale 6) and target share 45% (scale .20); RB carries 65% (scale 10), targets 35% (scale 5); QB attempts 80% (scale 15), carries 20% (scale 5). Each component change is clipped to ±1. Missing components are omitted and weights renormalized. No prior games means neutral 50. This is a transparent usage heuristic, not a calibrated investment forecast.
methodology.catalysts: No injury/depth catalyst is inferred automatically. Optional provider health is shown separately.
